chain.title: A reference for the RFTools family
chain.desc: Craft the RFTools manual and open the sections for the modules installed in this pack. Base supplies common components; Builder, Storage, Power, and Utility add their own systems.

chain.title: Prepare the shared machine base
chain.desc: Craft a Machine Base for the RFTools workshop. It is a common ingredient, not a working energy source or processor.

chain.title: Frames for the installed modules
chain.desc: Craft Machine Frames and choose a practical first machine from an installed RFTools module. The separate modules do not require completing an entire Base chapter first.

chain.title: Configure before connecting
chain.desc: Use the Smart Wrench to rotate, configure, or pick up supported RFTools blocks. Check its mode before interacting with a machine that has saved settings.

chain.title: Find a dimensional-shard source
chain.desc: Obtain Dimensional Shards from this pack's world generation, loot, or supported recipes. Keep them for infusion and advanced components rather than mining a specific decorative ore block for a quest.

chain.title: Improve selected RFTools machines
chain.desc: Supply the Machine Infuser with shards and a compatible machine. Check the infused machine's effect; infusion benefits depend on the device and do not replace its fuel or power supply.

chain.title: A component for advanced devices
chain.desc: Craft an Infused Diamond using the installed recipe. Choose the target device before spending rare materials on a stockpile of components.

chain.title: Prepare an infused ender component
chain.desc: Use the installed recipe to make an Infused Ender Pearl. It supports advanced RFTools devices where the relevant addon is present.

chain.title: A deliberate filter
chain.desc: Configure a Filter Module for the item set a compatible machine should accept or process. Test with a small inventory before placing it in an automated route.

chain.title: Save a useful crafting pattern
chain.desc: Make a Crafting Card for supported interfaces. Follow the consuming machine's instructions; the card alone is not an automatic crafting machine.

chain.title: Read the workshop information
chain.desc: Place an Information Screen where it is useful for the base's supported information display. More elaborate modular screens come from RFTools Utility.

chain.title: A host for remote controls
chain.desc: Craft and charge a Tablet, then install a supported control module from an available addon. The empty tablet does not provide storage or screen access until it is configured.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
limits: RFTools Base 1.20-5.0.7 is a shared foundation, so this guide intentionally stays short.
Dimensional shard generation and useful tablet modules depend on the installed pack and addons.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
